name: Frontier Stable Token
oneLiner: FRNT is Wyoming's dollar token, backed by a holder-benefit reserve trust and redeemable through approved service providers without a state guarantee.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills, repurchase agreements and USD cash in holder-benefit trust accounts managed by Franklin Advisers and held by Fiduciary Trust International
pegMechanism: The Wyoming Stable Token Commission issues and redeems FRNT at USD par through KYB-approved Licensed Service Providers. Reserve rules require ordinary redemption within two business days subject to specified exceptions; direct token-holder fallback is conditional. FRNT is a special obligation limited to trust assets, not Wyoming's general obligation or federally insured money. Native deployment liabilities share the reserve book; current cross-chain transfers use Chainlink CCIP.
